prompt:
Use case: isolated industrial-equipment component reconstruction
Asset type: one standalone reusable transparent PNG component for an editable industrial process diagram.
Input images: Image 1 is the approved full-slide concept; use it for this target assembly's compact position, silhouette, proportions, colors and lighting. Image 2 is the older transparent group of five machines; use it only to clarify the tank-and-pump construction.
Primary request: Reconstruct exactly one heat-recovery vessel and pump assembly from the references.
Subject: the lower-center assembly only: one upright brushed-stainless pressure vessel with rounded domed top and cylindrical shell, supported on three or four short metal legs; a compact blue industrial motor/pump mounted immediately to its right on the same low skid; one short, clearly attached metal pipe linking the tank outlet to the pump inlet, plus small local fittings. These parts are one joined equipment assembly in the source. Preserve the tank-left, pump-right relationship.
Style/medium: polished realistic industrial concept illustration matching the source's steel highlights, dark seams and blue motor casing, with fine fittings and realistic metal depth.
Composition/framing: show the complete compact horizontal assembly centered, upright and uncropped on a transparent landscape canvas with generous padding. Keep the vessel visibly taller than the pump and preserve the wide arrangement; no stretching or tilting.
Lighting: crisp neutral overhead highlights on stainless steel and soft blue reflections on the pump casing, attached to the surfaces.
Constraints: genuine transparent RGBA outside the single vessel/pump assembly. Keep its own short connecting pipe and skid; stop any pipe that would lead toward another machine at a visible flange. No environment or ground plane. A faint contact shadow may sit directly under the skid only.
Avoid: heating furnace, production line, exhaust tower, heat exchanger, long orange or teal routes, inter-device tubes, flow glow, arrows, badges, labels, text, room, paper, grid, horizon, floor plane, detached shadow, frame, border, watermark or cropped legs.

input_references.role: approved full-slide assembly placement and style

review: Agent visual review pending contact-sheet fit; one joined tank-left and blue pump-right assembly, no other equipment, route, text or background.
